title: Stable matching: original lesson, proposal trace and blocking-pair explorer
body:
## Learner outcome

An original 12-question lesson, worked guide and direct-file explorer will let a learner follow provisional holds, find concrete blocking pairs in a complete matching, and compare the stable outcomes selected by either proposing side.

Owner: `estate-81ba1ed0179c/root`, external source contributor; no resident Za/goal/lease claimed. Native reservation: `/srv/hamon-estate/coord/estate-81ba1ed0179c-recall-stable-matching.json`.

## Bounded contract

Strict complete equal-size preferences for 1–4 participants per side; deterministic lowest-index free proposer, one atomic proposal per trace step. Enumerate every complete matching (at most 24), show one-based ordinal ranks and every blocking-pair witness, and compare the final proposer ranks with all stable alternatives. No ties, missing partners, input coercion, fairness or real allocation claims.

The UI requires explicit Apply, retires observations when drafts change, supports reversible steps and explicit alternative-matching inspection, and downloads exact original course/guide bytes plus a source-bound complete observation. Validate actual direct-file desktop/390px keyboard behavior and import the downloaded lesson through the unchanged learner.

Frozen contract SHA256: `580e02f54caedb6dc962a7e6e134ae3fae4d6b4bc4f978f9cefc4eaad3597416`. Native base: `1c8ece2713554f95b0e507297a34909d50222736`; current main `698902f9c9c1d5c5023092b85b3632a7cb7a01ed` has no topic path overlap. Dedicated new stable-matching module, UI, template, course, builder, tests and receiving paths; one optional additive README entry after qualification. Existing learner/model/catalog/workflow/dependency paths and other course owners stay exact.

## Coordination and execution boundary

Maximum bipartite matching #133 explicitly excludes stable matching and retains its owner. Exact topic checks found no matching public/native ownership among 416 readable native records (21 permission denials respected), postfiltered Conscience evidence and 691 complete central comment objects. Original new-builder absence is retained as a failing baseline; source intake is exact.

Jacob’s [no GitHub Actions direction](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/hamon/issues/143#issuecomment-6067592767) is binding. Current full-tree inspection finds five unchanged workflows with push/pull_request events and no issue event, so this ownership issue does not start a configured workflow. Native implementation, qualification and custody proceed. Source ref/PR/merge publication remains held; no dispatch/rerun, workflow edits, skipped checks or gate bypass.
